description: This file defines API endpoints for managing recipes, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting recipes. It uses FastAPI, SQLAlchemy ORM models, and serialization functions to handle recipe data and relationships such as tags and ingredients.

methods.name: RecipeOut _serialize_recipe(recipe: models.Recipe, db: Session, user_id: Optional[int])
methods.description: Serializes a recipe object into RecipeOut schema, including favorite status for a user.

methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new recipe, associating tags and ingredients.

methods.name: _assert_owner(recipe: models.Recipe, user_id: int)
methods.description: Checks if the current user is the owner of the recipe, raises HTTP 403 if not.

methods.name: RecipeOut get_recipe( recipe_id: int, db: Session = Depends(db_session), current_user: models.User | None = Depends(lambda: None), )
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve a specific recipe by ID with user-specific favorite info.

methods.name: RecipeOut update_recipe( recipe_id: int, recipe_in: RecipeUpdate, db: Session = Depends(db_session), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_active_user), )
methods.description: Handles PUT/PATCH requests to update an existing recipe, including associations.

methods.name: None delete_recipe( recipe_id: int, db: Session = Depends(db_session), current_user: models.User = Depends(get_current_active_user), )
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a recipe, requiring ownership.
